definitions.explanation: The ability to see through to the true nature of things or to understand deeply. Often used for psychological or analytical perception.

examples.japanese: {鋭|するど}い{洞察力|どうさつりょく}
{彼|かれ}は{人|ひと}の{心|こころ}を{洞察|どうさつ}する{力|ちから}がある。
examples.english: He has the ability to see through people's hearts.

examples.japanese: この{小説|しょうせつ}には{人間|にんげん}{心理|しんり}への{深|ふか}い{洞察|どうさつ}が{見|み}られる。
examples.english: Deep insight into human psychology can be seen in this novel.

notes:
USAGE: {洞察|どうさつ} implies seeing beyond the surface to understand underlying truths. Often used with {力|りょく} to form {洞察力|どうさつりょく} (insight, perceptiveness).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洞察力|どうさつりょく} (insight, perceptiveness)
- {鋭|するど}い{洞察|どうさつ} (keen/sharp insight)
- {深|ふか}い{洞察|どうさつ} (deep insight)
- {洞察|どうさつ}を{得|え}る (to gain insight)

RELATED WORDS:
- {観察|かんさつ} (observation - more external, empirical)
- {察知|さっち} (perception - detecting/sensing)
- {見抜|みぬ}く (to see through - verb form)
